deadline.value: Course funding deadline Dec 8, 2026 (Gates Cambridge US round Oct 14, 2026). Final application deadline May 13, 2027 for an October 2027 start, but too late for university funding.
deadline.quote: Funding Deadlines Course Funding Deadline Dec. 8, 2026 | Michaelmas 2027 Applications open Sep. 9, 2026 Application deadline May. 13, 2027 Course starts Oct. 1, 2027

app_fee.value: GBP 20 per applicant per year of entry for doctoral courses (up to 7 applications)
app_fee.quote: Doctoral courses (including combined MRes + PhD courses): £20 per applicant, per academic year of entry. You can submit up to a maximum of 7 applications.

fee_waiver.value: A waiver exists for eligible applicants; eligibility criteria not shown on the page checked
fee_waiver.quote: You need to pay an application fee when you apply for a postgraduate course at Cambridge, unless you are eligible for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement listed on the pages checked

gre_physics.value: No GRE requirement listed on the pages checked

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with 25 in each section; IELTS 7.0 overall (Listening/Writing/Speaking 7.0, Reading 6.5)
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

english_waiver.value: Exemption needs nationality of, or a degree from, a 'majority English-speaking country' (UKVI list); India is not on that list
english_waiver.quote: you are a national of a majority English-speaking country and were educated in such a country

supervisor.value: Some PhD programmes need supervisor contact before applying; a 2027-28 supervisor list is published
supervisor.quote: For certain PhD and MPhil programmes, you may need to reach out to potential supervisors before applying.

funding.value: Not guaranteed: apply by the funding deadline to enter the University funding competition; otherwise secure your own support
funding.quote: Secure financial support if not awarded funding.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's-only holders normally also need a master's; India's 3-4 year bachelor's equivalency does not cover a UK master's
entry_route.quote: For students who only hold a bachelor's degree, a master's degree is normally required as well.

notes: Funding offers start being considered from February; offers of admission from November at the earliest.
